items.title: How do I check AI generated code for missing tests automatically?
items.body: I am struggling with PRs where AI wrote working code but skipped tests and duplicated logic. Is there a tool or script to audit generated code before review?

items.title: Best way to monitor forums for people asking for a tool like ours?
items.body: Our founder manually checks Reddit and Hacker News every day for posts from potential customers. We need to sync useful mentions into a spreadsheet without spammy outreach.

items.title: Simple onboarding analytics without a complex event pipeline
items.body: I manually export signup events every week, review a spreadsheet, and guess why users drop off. How are people doing onboarding analysis without a full analytics team?

items.title: Can someone recommend a GitHub Actions log analyzer?
items.body: CI failures are frustrating. The workflow logs take forever to scan, and every YAML mistake looks different. I want a tool that explains what to fix.

items.title: Automate Stripe export to Google Sheets client summary
items.body: Every Monday I manually export Stripe payments, import a CSV into Google Sheets, reconcile refunds, and send a client report. The repeat workflow is annoying and error-prone.
